goalIdentity.note: Draft identifiers assigned for mapping, not a frozen or submitted goal revision.

technicalProposalsNotUserStandards.verificationMapping: The draft maps existing user expectations to criterion IDs, stages and evidence types. These mappings propose execution methods; they do not add or relax user expectations.
technicalProposalsNotUserStandards.largeText: User confirmed the maximum system accessibility text-size category; concrete evaluation mapping is recorded in large-text-rubric.json. No M1 UI observation has occurred.
technicalProposalsNotUserStandards.observationDefaults: 30 minutes and 10 complete paths were explicitly confirmed for M1 in the latest reply. Observe foreground/liveness once per path (10 health observations) as the implementation mapping, not an extra independently requested health-probe threshold.
technicalProposalsNotUserStandards.implementationPaths: Mapped against the frozen release baseline in implementation-scope.json; use repository pages-first authority, existing shared/application identity and expo-clipboard. No RN source changes or executable policy installation.
technicalProposalsNotUserStandards.oldSpecText: Earlier M1 prose saying the feature/platform/model are unknown is superseded by the user confirmations above, not by an unreviewed new acceptance standard.
technicalProposalsNotUserStandards.executionPreparation: Version 1 execution-policy.draft.json, diagnostics-fixtures.json and diagnostics-case-pack.json map the confirmed standards to bounded methods. They are local prepared-not-protected materials, not installed policies, formal evidence or admission.
